meta.title: 500 Common and Practical English Verbs — Structured English Guide with Spanish Verb Translations
meta.example_structure: 5 practical tenses/forms × 2 examples = 10 examples per verb
meta.pronunciation_note: There is no single 'official' English pronunciation. This guide uses reference US IPA plus a Latin-American-friendly reading approximation as a learning aid; the IPA is the more precise phonetic reference.
meta.pattern_note: The pattern section includes prepositions, particles, complements, and structures that commonly occur with each verb. A pattern is not automatically required in every meaning.
meta.frequency_note: The 1–5 scales are pedagogical estimates, not an exact ranking from one single corpus.
meta.confusion_note: Special contrast notes are included for verbs that learners often confuse because of direct translation from Spanish.
meta.language_policy: All explanations, labels, contexts, grammar notes, pattern notes, collocation notes, and examples are in English. Only the verb translation field remains in Spanish.
